title: Luciferase assay system to monitor fibroblast growth factor signal disruption in human iPSCs
protocol: Dissolve each test chemical in an appropriate solvent according to the ECVAM study guidelines.
Check the concentration at which chemicals dissolved in DMSO can be dissolved in the culture medium.
Select appropriate stock solvents for each chemical based on the manufacturer’s datasheet.
Prepare stock solutions at a soluble concentration.
Determine storage temperature and duration in accordance with the datasheet.
Dilute stocks of poorly water-soluble chemicals 100-fold in StemFlex medium.
Centrifuge diluted samples at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes.
Visually check for precipitation after centrifugation.
If precipitation is observed, dilute stock solution with DMSO and then dilute 100-fold in the medium.
Remove Geltrex from the −80°C freezer.
Thaw Geltrex on ice.
Mix ice-cold DMEM/F-12 with Geltrex at a ratio of 100:1.
Add the Geltrex solution to culture wells in volumes as follows:
For 35 mm dish and 6-well plate, add 1.5 mL/well.
For 12-well plate, add 600 μL/well.
For 24-well plate, add 300 μL/well.
For 48-well plate, add 150 μL/well.
For 96-well plate, add 60 μL/well.
Incubate the culture plate with 1% Geltrex solution at 37°C in a CO2 incubator for at least 1 hour for coating.
Thaw frozen stock of iPS cells quickly in a 37°C water bath.
Pre-warm StemFlex medium (+ 10 μM Y-27632) to 37°C in a water bath.
Remove vial of cells from storage and thaw by gentle pipetting if volume is less than 200 μL.
Collect cell suspension in a 15 mL tube pre-filled with 4 mL StemFlex medium.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 200 × g for 4 minutes.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in fresh StemFlex medium (+ 10 μM Y-27632).
Remove Geltrex solution from pre-coated wells.
Seed cells in culture plates at densities as follows:
For 35 mm dish and 6-well plate, seed 1.25 × 10^5 cells/well.
Change medium to StemFlex the following day if few single cells are present.
Clump passage iPS cells using Versene Solution when culture reaches 60%–80% confluency.
Place the 6-well plate with 1% Geltrex solution in a CO2 incubator and incubate at 37°C for at least 1 hour.
Pre-warm StemFlex medium (+10 μM Y-27632) to 37°C in a water bath.
Equilibrate PBS and Versene Solution to room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Discard the medium from the culture wells.
Wash the wells once with 2 ml of PBS.
Add 1 ml of Versene Solution to the wells and let stand at room temperature for 5–8 minutes.
Discard the Versene Solution.
Wash the wells 4–5 times with medium to remove cells.
Discard Geltrex solution from pre-coated wells.
Add a 1/5 volume of cell suspension to the wells.
Single passage iPS cells using TrypLE Select Solution when culture reaches 60%–80% confluency.
Place the 6-well plate with 1% Geltrex solution in a CO2 incubator and incubate at 37°C for at least 1 hour.
Pre-warm StemFlex medium (+10 μM Y-27632) to 37°C in a water bath.
Equilibrate PBS and TrypLE Select Solution to room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Discard the medium from the culture wells.
Wash once with 2 ml of PBS.
Add 1 mL of TrypLE Select Solution to the wells.
Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Remove cells by gently pipetting 5-10 times with a 1000 μL pipette when cell adhesion weakens under a microscope.
Collect the cells in a 15 mL tube pre-filled with 4 mL of StemFlex medium.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 4 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and tap the tube 3-5 times to loosen the pellet.
Suspend the cells in 2 mL of StemFlex medium (+ 10 μM Y-27632) and pipette 5-10 times.
Mix a subset of the cell suspension 1:1 with trypan blue to measure viable cells.
Discard the Geltrex solution from pre-coated wells.
Seed cells in the wells at specified densities based on plate type.
Change medium to StemFlex medium if confluency exceeds 10% the following day.
Seed established cell lines in Geltrex-coated flat-bottomed 96-well culture plates at a density of 1.0 × 10^4 cells/well.
Fill the outermost wells of a 96-well plate with sterile water to prevent evaporation.
Replace the medium with 100 μL/well of StemFlex medium the following day.
Wait until cell confluency reaches 40%–60% before performing the cytotoxicity test.
Immediately prior to adding the chemical, replace the medium with 100 μL/well of StemFlex medium.
Add the chemical stock to the StemFlex medium so that the final solvent concentration does not exceed 10% for PBS and 1% for DMSO.
For chemicals not fully soluble in the medium, mix the chemical stock with DMSO and then add to StemFlex medium at the final concentration determined by solubility test.
Ensure the final concentration of DMSO in the medium is 1%.
Dilute the test chemical solution from step 10 with StemFlex medium to make a 2-fold dilution series.
Add 11 μL of diluted test chemical solution to each well.
For non-treated groups, provide a final concentration of 1% PBS or 0.1% DMSO depending on the solvent used for the test chemical.
Add 10 μl/well of CCK-8 twenty hours after adding the test chemical.
Incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 4 h.
Measure the absorbance at 450 nm in each well four hours after CCK-8 addition.
Subtract the absorbance of the blank from that of each sample well.
Compare the absorbance readings obtained under experimental conditions with those of the vehicle control group.
Calculate cell viability using the formula: Cell viability = (Abs sample - Abs blank) / (Abs vehicle - Abs blank).
Perform a total of at least three biological replicates.
Fit a four-parameter Log-Logistic curve using the LL.4 model of the drc package in R to estimate IC50.
Seed established cell lines in 96-well white plates at 1.0 × 10^4 cells/well, four days before adding the ligand.
Fill the outermost wells of a 96-well plate with sterile water to prevent evaporation.
Replace the medium with 200 μL/well of StemFlex medium the following day.
Replace the medium with 100 μL/well of APEL2 medium the day before ligand addition.
Replace the medium with 100 μL/well of APEL2 medium (+1% endurazine) at least 2 hours before adding the test chemical.
Measure the luminescence intensity of each well immediately before adding the chemical.
Add the chemical stock to APEL2 medium so that the final concentration of the solvent is at an upper limit of 10% for PBS and 1% for DMSO.
Ensure the final concentration of PBS or DMSO in the wells does not exceed 1% and 0.1%, respectively, after adding the chemical stock.
For chemicals with low water solubility, mix the chemical stock with DMSO before adding it to APEL2 medium at a final concentration determined by a solubility test.
Ensure the final concentration of DMSO in the medium does not exceed 1% after addition.
Dilute test chemical solution from step 21 with APEL2 medium to make a 2-fold dilution series with a total of 8 concentrations per chemical and add 11 μl to each well.
For non-treated groups, administer a final concentration of 1% PBS or 0.1% DMSO depending on the solvent of the test chemical.
Measure the luminescence intensity of each well immediately before ligand addition.
Add 12 μl/well of bFGF diluted to 20 ng/ml in APEL2 medium to a final concentration of 2 ng/ml.
For non-treated groups, prepare a solution of PBS (+ 0.1% BSA) and the bFGF solvent diluted 1000-fold in APEL2 medium and add 12 μl/well.
Measure the luminescence intensity of each well at repeated time intervals.
